source.text: קְרָ֤א בְגָרוֹן֙ אַל־תַּחְשֹׂ֔ךְ כַּשּׁוֹפָ֖ר הָרֵ֣ם קוֹלֶ֑ךָ וְהַגֵּ֤ד לְעַמִּי֙ פִּשְׁעָ֔ם וּלְבֵ֥ית יַעֲקֹ֖ב חַטֹּאתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Call out with [the] throat, do not hold back; like the trumpet raise your voice, and declare to my people their transgression, and to [the] house of Jacob their sins.

en.L: Call out with [full] throat, do not hold back; \q like the trumpet lift up your voice, \q and declare to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people their transgression, \q and to the house of Jacob their sins.
en.B: Shout with all your strength; hold nothing back. \q Let your voice ring out like a ram's horn. \q Make known to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people how they have rebelled, \q and to the house of Jacob what their sins are.
en.R: Shout as loud as you can. Do not stop. Make your voice as loud as a trumpet. \q Tell {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people how they have turned against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q Tell the people of Israel about their sins.

es.L: Clama a voz en cuello, no te detengas; \q como trompeta alza tu voz, \q y anuncia a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo su transgresión, \q y a la casa de Jacob sus pecados.
es.B: Grita con todas tus fuerzas; no te contengas. \q Que tu voz resuene como el cuerno de carnero. \q Dale a conocer a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo cómo se ha rebelado, \q y a la casa de Jacob cuáles son sus pecados.
es.R: Grita tan fuerte como puedas. No te detengas. Haz que tu voz suene tan fuerte como una trompeta. \q Dile a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo cómo se ha vuelto contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Dile al pueblo de Israel cuáles son sus pecados.

fr.L: Crie à pleine gorge, ne te retiens pas ; \q comme le cor élève ta voix, \q et annonce à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple sa transgression, \q et à la maison de Jacob ses péchés.
fr.B: Crie de toutes tes forces, ne te retiens pas. \q Fais retentir ta voix comme le cor. \q Fais connaître à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple sa révolte, \q et à la maison de Jacob ses péchés.
fr.R: Crie aussi fort que tu peux. Ne t’arrête pas. Fais résonner ta voix comme une trompette. \q Dis à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple comment il s’est révolté contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Dis aux gens d’Israël quels sont leurs péchés.

sw.L: Piga kelele kwa [nguvu za] koo, usizuie; \q kama baragumu paza sauti yako, \q uwatangazie watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} uasi wao, \q na nyumba ya Yakobo dhambi zao.
sw.B: Piga kelele kwa nguvu zako zote; usizuie kitu. \q Sauti yako na ivume kama baragumu. \q Wajulishe watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} jinsi walivyoasi, \q na nyumba ya Yakobo dhambi zao ni zipi.
sw.R: Piga kelele kwa sauti kubwa kadiri unavyoweza. Usinyamaze. Ifanye sauti yako iwe kubwa kama baragumu. \q Waambie watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} jinsi walivyoniasi. \q Waambie watu wa Israeli habari za dhambi zao.

decisions.choice: call out, do not hold back, raise: commands to one person, the prophet
decisions.reason: The verbs are singular. God sends his messenger to announce the people's sin openly, as Micah 3:8 describes the prophet's task.

decisions.choice: the trumpet: the ram's horn blown to warn or to gather the people
decisions.reason: The ram's horn sounded alarm in war and called assemblies (Hosea 8:1; Joel 2:1). The prophet's voice is to be as loud and as urgent.

decisions.choice: transgression: rebellion, breaking faith with God
decisions.reason: The word names a breach of loyalty, a revolt against a rightful lord (1:2; 43:27). Here it stands beside the more general word for sins.

decisions.choice: how they have turned against me; the people of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says what rebellion means and names the house of Jacob as the people of Israel.

decisions.choice: trompeta (L, R); cuerno de carnero (B)
decisions.reason: The *shofar*, as the English settles it: "trompeta" at Literal and Readable, "cuerno de carnero" at Balanced.

decisions.choice: baragumu
decisions.reason: The *shofar* (ram's horn) is "baragumu" at every level, as everywhere else in Isaiah and Jeremiah; "tarumbeta" is kept for the metal trumpet.

decisions.choice: "le cor" (L, B), "la trompette" (R)
decisions.reason: The *shofar* is "le cor" at Literal and Balanced, as the French of Samuel and Kings, and "la trompette" at Readable, as the English Readable, throughout Isaiah and Jeremiah.

source.text: וְאוֹתִ֗י י֥וֹם יוֹם֙ יִדְרֹשׁ֔וּן וְדַ֥עַת דְּרָכַ֖י יֶחְפָּצ֑וּן כְּג֞וֹי אֲשֶׁר־צְדָקָ֣ה עָשָׂ֗ה וּמִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֱלֹהָיו֙ לֹ֣א עָזָ֔ב יִשְׁאָל֨וּנִי֙ מִשְׁפְּטֵי־צֶ֔דֶק קִרְבַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֖ים יֶחְפָּצֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: And me day [after] day they seek, and [the] knowledge of my ways they desire, like a nation that righteousness has done and [the] judgment of its God has not forsaken; they ask me [for] judgments of righteousness, [the] nearness of God they desire.

en.L: Yet {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} day [after] day they seek, \q and the knowledge of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} ways they delight in, \q like a nation that has done righteousness and has not forsaken the justice of its God; \q they ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for righteous judgments; \q the nearness of God they delight in.
en.B: Day after day they come looking for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} \q and seem glad to learn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} ways, \q acting like a nation that does righteousness and has not turned away from the justice of its God. \q They ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for rulings that are right; \q drawing near to God gives them pleasure.
en.R: Every day they come to worship {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. They say they want to know how I want them to live. \q They act like a nation that does what is right and obeys the laws of its God. \q They ask {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to make fair decisions for them. \q They seem happy to come near to God.

es.L: Sin embargo, día [tras] día {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} buscan, \q y se deleitan en conocer {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} caminos, \q como nación que ha practicado la justicia y no ha abandonado el derecho de su Dios; \q {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} piden juicios justos; \q se deleitan en acercarse a Dios.
es.B: Día tras día {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} buscan \q y parecen contentos de aprender {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} caminos, \q actuando como una nación que practica la justicia y no se ha apartado del derecho de su Dios. \q Me piden decisiones justas; \q acercarse a Dios les da gusto.
es.R: Cada día vienen y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} adoran. Dicen que quieren saber cómo quiero yo que vivan. \q Actúan como una nación que hace lo que es justo y obedece las leyes de su Dios. \q Me piden que tome decisiones justas a su favor. \q Parecen felices de acercarse a Dios.

fr.L: Pourtant c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qu’ils cherchent jour après jour, \q et ils prennent plaisir à connaître {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} voies, \q comme une nation qui aurait pratiqué la justice et n’aurait pas abandonné le droit de son Dieu ; \q ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} demandent des jugements justes ; \q ils prennent plaisir à s’approcher de Dieu.
fr.B: Jour après jour, ils viennent {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} chercher \q et semblent heureux de connaître {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} chemins, \q comme une nation qui pratique la justice et n’a pas délaissé le droit de son Dieu. \q Ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} demandent des décisions justes ; \q s’approcher de Dieu leur fait plaisir.
fr.R: Chaque jour, ils viennent {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}adorer. Ils disent qu’ils veulent savoir comment je veux qu’ils vivent. \q Ils agissent comme une nation qui fait ce qui est juste et qui obéit aux lois de son Dieu. \q Ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} demandent de prendre des décisions justes pour eux. \q Ils semblent heureux de s’approcher de Dieu.

sw.L: Hata hivyo {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} wananitafuta siku kwa siku, \q na kuzijua njia {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} wanapenda, \q kama taifa lililotenda haki na halikuiacha hukumu ya Mungu wake; \q wananiomba hukumu za haki; \q kumkaribia Mungu wanapenda.
sw.B: Siku baada ya siku wanakuja kunitafuta \q na kuonekana wanafurahi kujifunza njia {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, \q wakijifanya kama taifa linalotenda haki na lisilowahi kuiacha haki ya Mungu wake. \q Wananiomba maamuzi yaliyo sawa; \q kumkaribia Mungu kunawapendeza.
sw.R: Kila siku wanakuja kuniabudu. Wanasema wanataka kujua jinsi ninavyotaka waishi. \q Wanajifanya kama taifa linalotenda yaliyo haki na kutii sheria za Mungu wake. \q Wananiomba niwafanyie maamuzi ya haki. \q Wanaonekana kufurahi kumkaribia Mungu.

decisions.choice: like a nation that does righteousness: their eagerness is outward; they act as if they were faithful
decisions.reason: The comparison "like a nation" hints that they are not such a nation. Verses 3-7 show that their worship does not touch how they treat others (1:11-17; 29:13).

decisions.choice: righteous judgments: just rulings or decisions from God
decisions.reason: They ask God to give right decisions, perhaps to rule in their favor; verse 3 shows them complaining that he does not act for them.

decisions.choice: the nearness of God: coming near to God in worship
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of drawing near to God at his house (Psalm 73:28).

decisions.choice: does what is right; fair decisions
decisions.reason: Righteousness here is right conduct and just rulings, so Readable says "what is right" and "fair".

decisions.choice: come to worship me; they say they want to know how I want them to live
decisions.reason: Readable explains "seek me" as worship and "my ways" as the way God wants them to live, and adds "they say" to keep the irony of the comparison.

source.text: לָ֤מָּה צַּ֨מְנוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א רָאִ֔יתָ עִנִּ֥ינוּ נַפְשֵׁ֖נוּ וְלֹ֣א תֵדָ֑ע הֵ֣ן בְּי֤וֹם צֹֽמְכֶם֙ תִּמְצְאוּ־חֵ֔פֶץ וְכָל־עַצְּבֵיכֶ֖ם תִּנְגֹּֽשׂוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Why have we fasted and you have not seen, humbled our soul and you do not know? Look, on [the] day of your fast you find pleasure, and all your laborers you drive hard.

en.L: "Why have we fasted, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have not seen? \q [Why] have we humbled our soul, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do not take notice?" \q Look, on the day of your fast you find [your own] pleasure, \q and all your workers you drive hard.
en.B: "We have fasted," they say, "so why do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} not see? \q We have humbled ourselves, so why do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} not notice?" \q But look: on the very day you fast, you pursue your own business \q and drive all your laborers hard.
en.R: The people ask God, "Why do we go without food, when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do not even see it? \q Why do we make ourselves humble, when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do not notice?" \q But on the days you fast, you do whatever you want. \q And you make your workers work too hard.

es.L: «¿Por qué hemos ayunado, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no lo has visto? \q ¿[Por qué] hemos humillado nuestra alma, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no te das por enterado?». \q {{plural_you:Miren, en el día de su ayuno ustedes buscan su|Mirad, en el día de vuestro ayuno vosotros buscáis vuestro}} [propio] gusto, \q y a todos {{plural_you:sus trabajadores los oprimen|vuestros trabajadores los oprimís}}.
es.B: «Hemos ayunado», dicen, «¿por qué no lo ves {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}? \q Nos hemos humillado, ¿por qué no lo notas?». \q Pero {{plural_you:miren: el mismo día en que ayunan, se ocupan de sus propios negocios|mirad: el mismo día en que ayunáis, os ocupáis de vuestros propios negocios}} \q y {{plural_you:explotan a todos sus trabajadores|explotáis a todos vuestros trabajadores}}.
es.R: El pueblo le pregunta a Dios: «¿Para qué dejamos de comer, si {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} ni siquiera lo ves? \q ¿Para qué nos humillamos, si {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no te das cuenta?». \q Pero los días en que {{plural_you:ayunan, ustedes hacen lo que quieren|ayunáis, vosotros hacéis lo que queréis}}. \q Y {{plural_you:hacen trabajar demasiado a sus trabajadores|hacéis trabajar demasiado a vuestros trabajadores}}.

fr.L: « Pourquoi avons-nous jeûné, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as pas vu ? \q [Pourquoi] avons-nous humilié notre âme, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’en sais rien ? » \q Voici, au jour de votre jeûne, vous trouvez [votre propre] plaisir, \q et tous vos ouvriers, vous les pressez.
fr.B: « Nous avons jeûné, disent-ils, pourquoi ne le vois-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pas ? \q Nous nous sommes humiliés, pourquoi n’en tiens-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pas compte ? » \q Mais voyez : le jour même où vous jeûnez, vous vaquez à vos propres affaires \q et vous faites trimer tous vos ouvriers.
fr.R: Le peuple demande à Dieu : « Pourquoi nous privons-nous de nourriture, si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne le vois même pas ? \q Pourquoi nous humilions-nous, si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’y fais pas attention ? » \q Mais les jours où vous jeûnez, vous faites tout ce que vous voulez. \q Et vous faites travailler trop durement vos ouvriers.

sw.L: "Kwa nini tumefunga, nawe hukuona? \q [Kwa nini] tumejinyenyekeza nafsi zetu, nawe hukujali?" \q Tazama, siku ya mfungo wenu mnatafuta [mapenzi yenu wenyewe], \q na wafanyakazi wenu wote mnawaendesha kwa nguvu.
sw.B: "Tumefunga," wanasema, "kwa nini basi huoni? \q Tumejinyenyekeza, kwa nini basi hujali?" \q Lakini tazameni: siku ileile mnayofunga, mnafuata shughuli zenu wenyewe \q na kuwasukuma kwa nguvu wafanyakazi wenu wote.
sw.R: Watu wanamwuliza Mungu, "Kwa nini tunakaa bila kula, wakati {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} huoni hata kidogo? \q Kwa nini tunajinyenyekeza, wakati {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hujali?" \q Lakini siku mnazofunga, mnafanya mnavyotaka. \q Na mnawafanyisha wafanyakazi wenu kazi kupita kiasi.

decisions.choice: the people's complaint is quoted, then God answers it
decisions.reason: The first half is the people's question to God; with "look" God replies and shows them why their fasting goes unheeded.

decisions.choice: humbled our soul: denied ourselves by fasting
decisions.reason: The expression is the Law's phrase for fasting on the Day of Atonement (Leviticus 16:29, 31; Psalm 35:13).

decisions.choice: pleasure: your own business or desire
decisions.reason: The word means what one wants or one's own affairs; in 58:13 it is set against keeping the Sabbath. Here they pursue their own interests while their workers labor.

decisions.choice: they say; the people ask God
decisions.reason: The speaker changes without warning, so Balanced and Readable say who is asking.

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros (plural_you)
decisions.reason: God's answer turns to the people in the plural ("your fast", "you find"), so it takes plural_you spans; the people's own question is addressed to God with "tú".

source.text: הֵ֣ן לְרִ֤יב וּמַצָּה֙ תָּצ֔וּמוּ וּלְהַכּ֖וֹת בְּאֶגְרֹ֣ף רֶ֑שַׁע לֹא־תָצ֣וּמוּ כַיּ֔וֹם לְהַשְׁמִ֥יעַ בַּמָּר֖וֹם קוֹלְכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, for strife and contention you fast, and to strike with [the] fist of wickedness; you do not fast as [the] day to make heard in [the] height your voice.

en.L: Look, for strife and quarreling you fast, \q and to strike with a wicked fist; \q you do not fast as [you do] today \q to make your voice heard on high.
en.B: Look, you fast, and then you wrangle and brawl \q and hit out with a vicious fist. \q Fasting the way you do now \q will never carry your voice up to the heights.
en.R: When you fast, you argue and fight. \q You even hit people with your fists. \q If you fast like this, your prayers will not reach heaven.

es.L: {{plural_you:Miren, para contienda y riña ayunan|Mirad, para contienda y riña ayunáis}}, \q y para golpear con puño de maldad; \q no {{plural_you:ayunan|ayunáis}} como hoy \q para hacer oír en lo alto {{plural_you:su voz|vuestra voz}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Miren, ayunan, y luego discuten y se pelean|Mirad, ayunáis, y luego discutís y os peleáis}} \q y {{plural_you:golpean|golpeáis}} con puño malvado. \q Ayunando como lo {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} ahora \q nunca {{plural_you:harán llegar su voz|haréis llegar vuestra voz}} a las alturas.
es.R: Cuando {{plural_you:ayunan, discuten y pelean|ayunáis, discutís y peleáis}}. \q Hasta {{plural_you:golpean|golpeáis}} a la gente con los puños. \q Si {{plural_you:ayunan así, sus oraciones|ayunáis así, vuestras oraciones}} no llegarán al cielo.

fr.L: Voici, pour la querelle et la dispute vous jeûnez, \q et pour frapper d’un poing méchant ; \q vous ne jeûnez pas comme [vous le faites] aujourd’hui \q pour faire entendre votre voix en haut.
fr.B: Voyez, vous jeûnez, et puis vous vous disputez et vous vous battez, \q et vous frappez d’un poing brutal. \q Jeûner comme vous le faites maintenant \q ne fera jamais monter votre voix jusqu’aux hauteurs.
fr.R: Quand vous jeûnez, vous vous disputez et vous vous battez. \q Vous frappez même les gens à coups de poing. \q Si vous jeûnez de cette façon, vos prières ne monteront pas jusqu’au ciel.

sw.L: Tazama, kwa ugomvi na mabishano mnafunga, \q na kupiga kwa ngumi ya uovu; \q hamfungi kama [mnavyofunga] leo \q ili sauti yenu isikike juu.
sw.B: Tazameni, mnafunga, kisha mnagombana na kupigana \q na kupiga kwa ngumi ya kikatili. \q Kufunga kama mnavyofunga sasa \q hakutaipeleka sauti yenu juu mbinguni kamwe.
sw.R: Mnapofunga, mnabishana na kupigana. \q Mnawapiga watu hata kwa ngumi. \q Mkifunga hivi, maombi yenu hayatafika mbinguni.

decisions.choice: as today: the way you fast now
decisions.reason: The phrase compares their present fasting with the fast God wants; it may also mean "on such a day".

decisions.choice: on high: in heaven, where God dwells
decisions.reason: The height is God's dwelling (57:15; 33:5). Their cries do not reach him.

decisions.choice: a fist of wickedness: blows struck in malice
decisions.reason: Fasting has not stopped them from violence against others (Exodus 21:18 uses the same word for a fist).

decisions.choice: your prayers will not reach heaven
decisions.reason: Readable says that the voice is their prayer and the height is heaven.

source.text: הֲכָזֶ֗ה יִֽהְיֶה֙ צ֣וֹם אֶבְחָרֵ֔הוּ י֛וֹם עַנּ֥וֹת אָדָ֖ם נַפְשׁ֑וֹ הֲלָכֹ֨ף כְּאַגְמֹ֜ן רֹאשׁ֗וֹ וְשַׂ֤ק וָאֵ֨פֶר֙ יַצִּ֔יעַ הֲלָזֶה֙ תִּקְרָא־צ֔וֹם וְי֥וֹם רָצ֖וֹן לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Like this is it, [the] fast [that] I choose, a day [for] a man to humble his soul? To bow down like a reed his head, and sackcloth and ashes he spreads [as a bed]? Is this [what] you call a fast and a day of acceptance to Yahweh?

en.L: Is the fast I choose like this: \q a day for a person to humble his soul? \q To bend down his head like a bulrush, and [to] make sackcloth and ashes [his] bed? \q Will you call this a fast, \q and a day of favor to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?
en.B: Do you think this is the fast I choose: \q a day when people deny themselves, \q droop their heads like a bulrush, and make their bed on sackcloth and ashes? \q Do you call that a fast, \q a day that wins the favor of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?
en.R: You think the kind of fasting I want is a day when people make themselves suffer. \q They bow their heads like a tall plant bending over. \q They lie down on rough cloth and ashes. \q Do you really call that fasting? \q Do you think {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is pleased with that?

es.L: ¿Es como este el ayuno que yo escojo: \q un día en que el hombre humille su alma? \q ¿Que incline su cabeza como un junco, y [que] haga de cilicio y ceniza [su] lecho? \q ¿Llamarás a esto ayuno, \q y día agradable {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}?
es.B: ¿Crees que este es el ayuno que yo escojo: \q un día en que la gente se mortifica, \q agacha la cabeza como un junco y se acuesta sobre cilicio y ceniza? \q ¿A eso llamas ayuno, \q un día que se gana el favor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?
es.R: Crees que el ayuno que yo quiero es un día en que la gente se hace sufrir. \q Inclinan la cabeza como una planta alta que se dobla. \q Se acuestan sobre ropa áspera de luto y ceniza. \q ¿De veras llamas a eso ayunar? \q ¿Crees que eso le agrada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}?

fr.L: Est-ce là le jeûne que je choisis : \q un jour où l’on humilie son âme ? \q Courber sa tête comme un jonc, et se coucher sur le sac et la cendre ? \q Appelleras-tu cela un jeûne, \q et un jour agréable {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ?
fr.B: Pensez-vous que c’est là le jeûne que je choisis : \q un jour où l’on se prive, \q où l’on baisse la tête comme un jonc et où l’on se couche sur le sac et la cendre ? \q Appelez-vous cela un jeûne, \q un jour qui obtient la faveur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ?
fr.R: Vous pensez que le jeûne que je veux, c’est un jour où les gens se font souffrir. \q Ils baissent la tête comme une grande herbe qui se courbe. \q Ils se couchent sur une toile grossière et sur de la cendre. \q Appelez-vous vraiment cela jeûner ? \q Pensez-vous que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est content de cela ?

sw.L: Je, mfungo ninaouchagua ni kama huu: \q siku ya mtu kujinyenyekeza nafsi yake? \q Kuinamisha kichwa chake kama unyasi, na kufanya gunia na majivu [kuwa] kitanda [chake]? \q Je, hili mtaliita mfungo, \q na siku ya kibali kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?
sw.B: Je, mnadhani huu ndio mfungo ninaouchagua: \q siku ambayo watu wanajinyima, \q wanainamisha vichwa vyao kama unyasi, na kutandika kitanda chao juu ya gunia na majivu? \q Je, mnaliita hilo mfungo, \q siku inayopata kibali cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?
sw.R: Mnadhani mfungo ninaoutaka ni siku ambayo watu wanajitesa. \q Wanainamisha vichwa vyao kama mmea mrefu uliopinda. \q Wanalala juu ya nguo za magunia na majivu. \q Je, kweli mnaita hilo mfungo? \q Mnadhani {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapendezwa na hilo?

decisions.choice: the questions expect the answer no
decisions.reason: God does not reject fasting itself but fasting that stops at outward signs, as verses 6-7 go on to show (Joel 2:13; Zechariah 7:5-10).

decisions.choice: sackcloth and ashes: signs of grief and repentance
decisions.reason: People wore rough goat-hair cloth and sat or lay in ashes to show mourning or sorrow for sin (Esther 4:3; Jonah 3:6).

decisions.choice: a day of acceptance: a day God accepts with favor
decisions.reason: The word is used of offerings that God accepts (56:7; Leviticus 1:3).

decisions.choice: a tall plant bending over; rough cloth
decisions.reason: Readable explains the bulrush and the sackcloth with plain words.

source.text: הֲל֣וֹא זֶה֮ צ֣וֹם אֶבְחָרֵהוּ֒ פַּתֵּ֨חַ֙ חַרְצֻבּ֣וֹת רֶ֔שַׁע הַתֵּ֖ר אֲגֻדּ֣וֹת מוֹטָ֑ה וְשַׁלַּ֤ח רְצוּצִים֙ חָפְשִׁ֔ים וְכָל־מוֹטָ֖ה תְּנַתֵּֽקוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Is not this [the] fast [that] I choose: to loosen [the] bonds of wickedness, to untie [the] cords of [the] yoke-bar, and to send [the] crushed [ones away] free, and every yoke-bar you will tear apart?

en.L: Is not this the fast I choose: \q to loose the bonds of wickedness, \q to untie the cords of the yoke-bar, \q and to send away the crushed [as] free [people], \q and every yoke-bar you shall tear apart?
en.B: No, this is the fast I choose: \q loose the bonds that wickedness has tied, \q untie the ropes of the yoke, \q send the crushed away free, \q and tear every yoke in two.
en.R: This is the kind of fasting I really want: \q Set free the people you have tied up unfairly. \q Take off the heavy loads you have put on them. \q Let the people you have crushed go free. \q Break everything that holds them in bondage.

es.L: ¿No es este el ayuno que yo escojo: \q desatar las ligaduras de la maldad, \q soltar las cuerdas del yugo, \q y dejar ir libres a los quebrantados, \q y que {{plural_you:rompan|rompáis}} todo yugo?
es.B: No, este es el ayuno que yo escojo: \q soltar las ataduras que ató la maldad, \q desatar las sogas del yugo, \q dejar libres a los oprimidos \q y romper todo yugo en dos.
es.R: Esta es la clase de ayuno que de verdad quiero: \q Liberar a la gente que han atado injustamente. \q Quitarles las cargas pesadas que les han puesto. \q Dejar ir libres a los que han aplastado. \q Romper todo lo que los tiene esclavizados.

fr.L: N’est-ce pas ceci, le jeûne que je choisis : \q délier les liens de la méchanceté, \q défaire les cordes du joug, \q et renvoyer libres ceux qui sont écrasés, \q et que vous brisiez tout joug ?
fr.B: Non, voici le jeûne que je choisis : \q dénouer les liens qu’a noués la méchanceté, \q détacher les cordes du joug, \q renvoyer libres ceux qu’on écrase, \q et briser tout joug.
fr.R: Voici le jeûne que je veux vraiment : \q Libérez les gens que vous avez enchaînés injustement. \q Enlevez les lourdes charges que vous leur avez imposées. \q Laissez partir libres ceux que vous avez écrasés. \q Brisez tout ce qui les tient en esclavage.

sw.L: Je, huu sio mfungo ninaouchagua: \q kulegeza vifungo vya uovu, \q kufungua kamba za nira, \q na kuwaachia huru waliopondwa, \q na kila nira mtaivunja?
sw.B: Hapana, huu ndio mfungo ninaouchagua: \q fungueni vifungo ambavyo uovu umefunga, \q fungueni kamba za nira, \q waacheni huru waliopondwa, \q na vunjeni kila nira vipande viwili.
sw.R: Huu ndio mfungo ninaoutaka kweli: \q Waweke huru watu mliowafunga isivyo haki. \q Waondoleeni mizigo mizito mliyowatwika. \q Waacheni huru watu mliowaponda. \q Vunjeni kila kitu kinachowashika utumwani.

decisions.choice: the yoke: forced labor and oppression
decisions.reason: The yoke-bar was the wooden crossbar tied to an animal's neck. It pictures bondage that others impose (9:3; 10:27; Leviticus 26:13).

decisions.choice: send away free: the word of the Law's release of slaves
decisions.reason: "Free" is the word used for freeing a slave (Exodus 21:2; Deuteronomy 15:12). Jeremiah 34:8-17 condemns Judah for releasing its slaves and taking them back.

decisions.choice: you shall tear apart: the list ends with a direct command
decisions.reason: After the infinitives, the last line turns to the hearer, as if to say: break every yoke yourselves.

decisions.choice: No, this is the fast I choose
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer yes, so Balanced and Readable state it plainly.

decisions.choice: the people you have tied up unfairly; heavy loads; everything that holds them in bondage
decisions.reason: Readable explains the bonds and the yoke as injustice and bondage.

source.text: הֲל֨וֹא פָרֹ֤ס לָֽרָעֵב֙ לַחְמֶ֔ךָ וַעֲנִיִּ֥ים מְרוּדִ֖ים תָּ֣בִיא בָ֑יִת כִּֽי־תִרְאֶ֤ה עָרֹם֙ וְכִסִּית֔וֹ וּמִבְּשָׂרְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תִתְעַלָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Is it not to break for the hungry your bread, and [the] poor homeless [ones] you bring [to the] house; when you see [the] naked, and you cover him, and from your [own] flesh not hide yourself?

en.L: Is it not breaking your bread for the hungry, \q and bringing the poor [who] wander homeless [into your] house? \q When you see [one who is] naked, you clothe him, \q and from your own flesh you do not hide yourself.
en.B: Is it not to break your bread with someone who is hungry, \q to take the wandering poor into your home, \q to clothe the naked person you meet, \q and never to turn your back on your own kin?
en.R: I want you to share your food with hungry people. \q Bring poor people who have no home into your house. \q When you see people who need clothes, give them clothes. \q Do not turn away from your own relatives when they need help.

es.L: ¿No es partir tu pan con el hambriento, \q y llevar a [tu] casa a los pobres sin hogar? \q Cuando veas al desnudo, que lo cubras, \q y que no te escondas de tu propia carne.
es.B: ¿No es compartir tu pan con el que tiene hambre, \q acoger en tu casa al pobre que anda sin rumbo, \q vestir al desnudo que encuentres \q y no dar nunca la espalda a los de tu propia sangre?
es.R: Quiero que compartas tu comida con la gente que tiene hambre. \q Lleva a tu casa a los pobres que no tienen hogar. \q Cuando veas a alguien que necesita ropa, dale ropa. \q No le des la espalda a tus propios parientes cuando necesiten ayuda.

fr.L: N’est-ce pas rompre ton pain pour l’affamé, \q et faire entrer [dans ta] maison les pauvres sans abri ? \q Quand tu vois [quelqu’un] nu, que tu le couvres, \q et que tu ne te dérobes pas devant ta propre chair.
fr.B: N’est-ce pas partager ton pain avec celui qui a faim, \q accueillir chez toi les pauvres sans abri, \q vêtir celui que tu vois nu, \q et ne jamais te dérober devant ceux de ton sang ?
fr.R: Je veux que tu partages ta nourriture avec ceux qui ont faim. \q Fais entrer chez toi les pauvres qui n’ont pas de maison. \q Quand tu vois quelqu’un qui n’a pas de vêtements, donne-lui des vêtements. \q Ne te détourne pas de ta propre famille quand elle a besoin d’aide.

sw.L: Je, si kumega mkate wako kwa mwenye njaa, \q na kuwaleta maskini [wanaotangatanga] bila makao [katika] nyumba [yako]? \q Unapomwona aliye uchi, umvike, \q wala usijifiche mbali na nyama yako mwenyewe.
sw.B: Je, si kumega mkate wako pamoja na mwenye njaa, \q kuwakaribisha nyumbani kwako maskini wanaotangatanga, \q kumvika nguo aliye uchi unayekutana naye, \q na kamwe kutowageuzia mgongo ndugu zako mwenyewe?
sw.R: Nataka mgawe chakula chenu na watu wenye njaa. \q Wakaribisheni nyumbani kwenu maskini wasio na makao. \q Mnapowaona watu wasio na nguo, wapeni nguo. \q Msiwapuuze ndugu zenu wanapohitaji msaada.

decisions.choice: your own flesh: your relatives and fellow members of your people
decisions.reason: "Flesh" means kin (Genesis 29:14; 37:27; Nehemiah 5:5). Some take it more widely of every fellow human being.

decisions.choice: homeless: wandering, without a settled home
decisions.reason: The word is used of wandering and homelessness in Lamentations 1:7 and 3:19.

decisions.choice: break your bread: share your food
decisions.reason: Bread was baked in flat loaves broken by hand; to break it for someone is to share a meal (Jeremiah 16:7).

decisions.choice: when they need help
decisions.reason: Readable says when one might hide from one's relatives.

source.text: אָ֣ז יִבָּקַ֤ע כַּשַּׁ֨חַר֙ אוֹרֶ֔ךָ וַאֲרֻכָתְךָ֖ מְהֵרָ֣ה תִצְמָ֑ח וְהָלַ֤ךְ לְפָנֶ֨יךָ֙ צִדְקֶ֔ךָ כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה יַאַסְפֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Then will break forth like the dawn your light, and your healing quickly will spring up; and will go before you your righteousness, [the] glory of Yahweh will be your rear guard.

en.L: Then like the dawn your light will break forth, \q and your healing will sprout quickly; \q and your righteousness will walk ahead of you, \q [and] the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be your rear guard.
en.B: Then like the dawn your light will break forth, \q and your healing will spring up without delay. \q Your righteousness will march ahead of you, \q and the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will guard you from behind.
en.R: If you do these things, your light will shine out like the sunrise. \q You will heal quickly. \q Your righteousness will lead the way in front of you. \q And the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will protect you from behind.

es.L: Entonces como el alba despuntará tu luz, \q y tu sanidad brotará pronto; \q e irá delante de ti tu justicia, \q [y] la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} será tu retaguardia.
es.B: Entonces tu luz despuntará como el alba, \q y tu sanidad brotará sin demora. \q Tu justicia marchará delante de ti, \q y la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} te guardará por detrás.
es.R: Si haces estas cosas, tu luz brillará como la salida del sol. \q Sanarás pronto. \q Tu justicia irá delante de ti abriendo el camino. \q Y la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} te protegerá por detrás.

fr.L: Alors ta lumière jaillira comme l’aurore, \q et ta guérison germera vite ; \q et ta justice marchera devant toi, \q [et] la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sera ton arrière-garde.
fr.B: Alors ta lumière poindra comme l’aurore, \q et ta guérison germera sans tarder. \q Ta justice marchera devant toi, \q et la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} te protégera par-derrière.
fr.R: Si tu fais cela, ta lumière brillera comme le lever du soleil. \q Tu guériras vite. \q Ta justice ouvrira la route devant toi. \q Et la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} te protégera par-derrière.

sw.L: Ndipo nuru yako itapambazuka kama alfajiri, \q na uponyaji wako utachipuka upesi; \q na haki yako itakutangulia, \q [na] utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utakuwa mlinzi wako wa nyuma.
sw.B: Ndipo nuru yako itapambazuka kama alfajiri, \q na uponyaji wako utachipuka bila kukawia. \q Haki yako itatembea mbele yako, \q na utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utakulinda kutoka nyuma.
sw.R: Mkifanya mambo haya, nuru yenu itang'aa kama mapambazuko. \q Mtapona upesi. \q Haki yenu itawaongoza mbele yenu. \q Na utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utawalinda kutoka nyuma.

decisions.choice: your light: well-being and God's saving favor after a time of darkness
decisions.reason: Light stands for life and rescue, darkness for distress (9:1; 60:1-3). Verse 10 returns to the picture.

decisions.choice: going before you, guarding the rear: the march out of Egypt
decisions.reason: At the exodus God's presence went before Israel and moved behind them to protect them (Exodus 14:19-20). Isaiah 52:12 uses the same rear-guard word of God.

decisions.choice: your righteousness: the right living just described, which God vindicates
decisions.reason: It may be the people's own just conduct or the vindication God gives them; the two belong together here (54:17; 62:1-2).

decisions.choice: If you do these things
decisions.reason: Readable says what "then" refers back to: the fast of verses 6-7.

source.text: אָ֤ז תִּקְרָא֙ וַיהוָ֣ה יַעֲנֶ֔ה תְּשַׁוַּ֖ע וְיֹאמַ֣ר הִנֵּ֑נִי אִם־תָּסִ֤יר מִתּֽוֹכְךָ֙ מוֹטָ֔ה שְׁלַ֥ח אֶצְבַּ֖ע וְדַבֶּר־אָֽוֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: Then you will call, and Yahweh will answer; you will cry for help, and he will say, Here I [am]. If you remove from your midst [the] yoke-bar, [the] stretching out of [the] finger, and speaking wickedness,

en.L: Then you will call, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will answer; \q you will cry for help, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will say, "Here I [am]." \q If you remove from your midst the yoke-bar, \q the pointing of the finger, and speaking wickedness,
en.B: Then when you call, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will answer; \q when you cry out for help, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will say, "I am here." \q If you do away with the yoke among you, \q the finger pointed in scorn, and words that do harm,
en.R: Then you will call to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will answer you. \q He will say, "I am here." \q Stop forcing hard labor on others. \q Stop pointing your finger to accuse people. Stop saying evil things about them.

es.L: Entonces clamarás, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} responderá; \q pedirás auxilio, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dirá: «Aquí [estoy]». \q Si quitas de en medio de ti el yugo, \q el señalar con el dedo y el hablar maldad,
es.B: Entonces, cuando llames, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} responderá; \q cuando pidas ayuda, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dirá: «Aquí estoy». \q Si acabas con el yugo entre los tuyos, \q con el dedo que señala con desprecio y con las palabras que hacen daño,
es.R: Entonces llamarás {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} pidiendo ayuda, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te responderá. \q Él dirá: «Aquí estoy». \q Deja de obligar a otros a hacer trabajos pesados. \q Deja de señalar con el dedo para acusar a la gente. Deja de decir cosas malas de ellos.

fr.L: Alors tu appelleras, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} répondra ; \q tu crieras au secours, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dira : « Me voici. » \q Si tu ôtes du milieu de toi le joug, \q le doigt pointé et la parole méchante,
fr.B: Alors, quand tu appelleras, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} répondra ; \q quand tu crieras au secours, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dira : « Je suis là. » \q Si tu fais disparaître du milieu de toi le joug, \q le doigt pointé avec mépris et les paroles qui blessent,
fr.R: Alors tu appelleras {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au secours, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te répondra. \q Il dira : « Je suis là. » \q Arrête d’imposer aux autres des travaux forcés. \q Arrête de pointer le doigt pour accuser les gens. Arrête de dire du mal d’eux.

sw.L: Ndipo utaita, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atajibu; \q utalia kuomba msaada, naye atasema, "Mimi hapa." \q Ukiondoa katikati yako nira, \q kunyoosha kidole, na kusema uovu,
sw.B: Ndipo utakapoita, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atajibu; \q utakapolia kuomba msaada, atasema, "Niko hapa." \q Ukiikomesha nira katikati yenu, \q kidole kinachonyooshwa kwa dharau, na maneno yanayodhuru,
sw.R: Ndipo mtamwita {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awasaidie, naye atawajibu. \q Atasema, "Niko hapa." \q Acheni kuwalazimisha wengine kufanya kazi ngumu. \q Acheni kunyoosha vidole vyenu kuwashtaki watu. Acheni kusema mabaya juu yao.

decisions.choice: Here I am: God answers with the words his servants use to answer him
decisions.reason: "Here I am" is the reply of one ready to serve (6:8; Genesis 22:1). In 65:1 God says it to a people who did not seek him.

decisions.choice: the pointing of the finger: scorn or false accusation
decisions.reason: A gesture of contempt or of plotting against a neighbor (Proverbs 6:13).

decisions.choice: if: a condition that runs on into verse 10
decisions.reason: The sentence continues: if you remove these things and care for the hungry, then your light will rise.

decisions.choice: Stop forcing hard labor on others ...
decisions.reason: Readable turns the long condition into short commands and explains the yoke as forced labor; verse 10 then says what follows.

source.text: וְתָפֵ֤ק לָֽרָעֵב֙ נַפְשֶׁ֔ךָ וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ נַעֲנָ֖ה תַּשְׂבִּ֑יעַ וְזָרַ֤ח בַּחֹ֨שֶׁךְ֙ אוֹרֶ֔ךָ וַאֲפֵלָתְךָ֖ כַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: and you offer to the hungry your soul, and [the] afflicted soul you satisfy, then will rise in the darkness your light, and your gloom [will be] like the noonday.

en.L: and [if] you bring out your soul to the hungry \q and satisfy the afflicted soul, \q then in the darkness your light will rise, \q and your gloom [will be] like midday.
en.B: if you give of yourself to the hungry \q and meet the needs of those who suffer, \q then your light will dawn in the darkness, \q and your gloom will be like the brightness of midday.
en.R: Give yourself to help hungry people. \q Give suffering people what they need. \q Then your light will shine in the dark. \q Your darkness will become as bright as the middle of the day.

es.L: y ofreces tu alma al hambriento \q y sacias al alma afligida, \q entonces en las tinieblas brillará tu luz, \q y tu oscuridad [será] como el mediodía.
es.B: si te das a ti mismo al hambriento \q y satisfaces las necesidades de los que sufren, \q entonces tu luz amanecerá en las tinieblas, \q y tu oscuridad será como la claridad del mediodía.
es.R: Entrégate a ayudar a la gente que tiene hambre. \q Dales a los que sufren lo que necesitan. \q Entonces tu luz brillará en la oscuridad. \q Tu oscuridad se volverá tan clara como el mediodía.

fr.L: et [si] tu donnes ton âme à l’affamé \q et rassasies l’âme affligée, \q alors ta lumière se lèvera dans les ténèbres, \q et ton obscurité [sera] comme le plein midi.
fr.B: si tu te donnes toi-même à celui qui a faim \q et combles les besoins de celui qui souffre, \q alors ta lumière se lèvera dans les ténèbres, \q et ton obscurité sera comme l’éclat de midi.
fr.R: Donne-toi pour aider ceux qui ont faim. \q Donne à ceux qui souffrent ce dont ils ont besoin. \q Alors ta lumière brillera dans le noir. \q Ton obscurité deviendra aussi claire que le milieu du jour.

sw.L: na [ukimtolea] mwenye njaa nafsi yako \q na kuishibisha nafsi iliyoteswa, \q ndipo nuru yako itachomoza gizani, \q na giza lako [litakuwa] kama adhuhuri.
sw.B: ukijitoa mwenyewe kwa ajili ya wenye njaa \q na kuwatimizia mahitaji yao wanaoteseka, \q ndipo nuru yako itapambazuka gizani, \q na giza lako litakuwa kama mwanga wa adhuhuri.
sw.R: Jitoleeni kuwasaidia watu wenye njaa. \q Wapeni wanaoteseka kile wanachohitaji. \q Ndipo nuru yenu itang'aa gizani. \q Giza lenu litakuwa angavu kama mchana wa saa sita.

decisions.choice: your soul: yourself, your own life and desire
decisions.reason: To hold out your soul to the hungry is to give yourself, not only your goods. The Septuagint reads "your bread from your soul" (from memory; check), which may reflect a different Hebrew text or an explanation.

decisions.choice: the afflicted soul: the person who is suffering and in need
decisions.reason: "Soul" here is the person with their hunger and want (Psalm 107:9).

decisions.choice: light rising in darkness, gloom like noon: trouble turned to well-being
decisions.reason: The picture picks up verse 8 and answers the darkness the people complain of in 59:9-10.

source.text: וְנָחֲךָ֣ יְהוָה֮ תָּמִיד֒ וְהִשְׂבִּ֤יעַ בְּצַחְצָחוֹת֙ נַפְשֶׁ֔ךָ וְעַצְמֹתֶ֖יךָ יַחֲלִ֑יץ וְהָיִ֨יתָ֙ כְּגַ֣ן רָוֶ֔ה וּכְמוֹצָ֣א מַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יְכַזְּב֖וּ מֵימָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And Yahweh will lead you continually, and he will satisfy in parched places your soul, and your bones he will strengthen; and you will be like a garden watered, and like a spring of waters whose waters do not fail.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will lead you always, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will fill your soul in sun-scorched lands, \q and your bones {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will make strong; \q and you will be like a well-watered garden, \q and like a source of water whose waters do not prove false.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will guide you without ceasing. \q He will satisfy your hunger in a sunbaked land \q and give strength to your bones. \q You will be like a garden with plenty of water, \q like a spring whose flow never stops.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will always lead you. \q He will give you what you need, even in a dry desert. \q He will make your body strong. \q You will be like a garden that gets plenty of water. \q You will be like a spring of water that never dries up.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te guiará siempre, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} saciará tu alma en tierras abrasadas, \q y tus huesos {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} fortalecerá; \q y serás como huerto regado, \q y como manantial de aguas cuyas aguas no engañan.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te guiará sin cesar. \q Saciará tu hambre en una tierra quemada por el sol \q y dará fuerza a tus huesos. \q Serás como un huerto bien regado, \q como un manantial que nunca deja de correr.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te guiará siempre. \q Te dará lo que necesitas, aun en un desierto seco. \q Hará fuerte tu cuerpo. \q Serás como un huerto que recibe mucha agua. \q Serás como un manantial de agua que nunca se seca.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te conduira continuellement, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rassasiera ton âme dans les lieux brûlés, \q et tes os, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les fortifiera ; \q et tu seras comme un jardin bien arrosé, \q et comme une source d’eau dont les eaux ne mentent pas.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te guidera sans cesse. \q Il te rassasiera dans une terre desséchée par le soleil \q et donnera de la force à tes os. \q Tu seras comme un jardin bien arrosé, \q comme une source dont l’eau ne s’arrête jamais.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te conduira toujours. \q Il te donnera ce dont tu as besoin, même dans un désert sec. \q Il rendra ton corps fort. \q Tu seras comme un jardin qui reçoit beaucoup d’eau. \q Tu seras comme une source qui ne tarit jamais.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuongoza daima, \q naye atashibisha nafsi yako katika nchi zilizounguzwa na jua, \q na mifupa yako ataifanya imara; \q nawe utakuwa kama bustani iliyonyweshwa vizuri, \q na kama chemchemi ya maji ambayo maji yake hayadanganyi.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuongoza bila kukoma. \q Ataishibisha njaa yako katika nchi iliyokaushwa na jua \q na kuitia nguvu mifupa yako. \q Utakuwa kama bustani yenye maji tele, \q kama chemchemi ambayo mtiririko wake haukomi kamwe.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawaongoza siku zote. \q Atawapa mnachohitaji hata katika jangwa kavu. \q Ataifanya miili yenu kuwa na nguvu. \q Mtakuwa kama bustani inayopata maji mengi. \q Mtakuwa kama chemchemi ya maji isiyokauka kamwe.

decisions.choice: parched places: land scorched dry by the sun
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here; it comes from a root meaning dry and glaring.

decisions.choice: strengthen your bones: renew your whole body and vigor
decisions.reason: Bones stand for the whole person's strength (66:14; Proverbs 3:8).

decisions.choice: do not fail: literally do not lie, a spring that does not disappoint
decisions.reason: A stream that dries up in summer is called deceptive (Jeremiah 15:18); this spring never lets the thirsty down.

decisions.choice: your body
decisions.reason: Readable says "body" for the bones, which stand for the whole person.

source.text: וּבָנ֤וּ מִמְּךָ֙ חָרְב֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם מוֹסְדֵ֥י דוֹר־וָד֖וֹר תְּקוֹמֵ֑ם וְקֹרָ֤א לְךָ֙ גֹּדֵ֣ר פֶּ֔רֶץ מְשֹׁבֵ֥ב נְתִיב֖וֹת לָשָֽׁבֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will build from you [the] ruins of antiquity; [the] foundations of generation and generation you will raise up; and it will be called to you, [One who] walls up a breach, Restorer of paths to dwell.

en.L: And [those] from among you will rebuild the ancient ruins; \q the foundations of many generations you will raise up; \q and you will be called Repairer of the Breach, \q Restorer of Paths for Dwelling.
en.B: Your people will build again the ruins left from long ago; \q you will raise up foundations laid generations back. \q You will be named the one who closes the gap in the wall, \q the one who makes the roads fit to live beside.
en.R: Your people will rebuild the cities that were destroyed long ago. \q You will build on the old foundations again. \q People will call you the one who fixes broken walls \q and makes the streets ready for people to live in again.

es.L: Y [los] de entre ti reedificarán las ruinas antiguas; \q los cimientos de generación y generación levantarás; \q y te llamarán Reparador de Brechas, \q Restaurador de Senderos para Habitar.
es.B: Tu gente reconstruirá las ruinas que quedaron de hace mucho; \q levantarás cimientos puestos hace generaciones. \q Te llamarán el que cierra la brecha del muro, \q el que deja los caminos listos para que se viva junto a ellos.
es.R: Tu gente reconstruirá las ciudades que fueron destruidas hace mucho tiempo. \q Volverás a edificar sobre los cimientos antiguos. \q La gente te llamará el que arregla los muros rotos \q y prepara las calles para que la gente vuelva a vivir en ellas.

fr.L: Et [des gens] de chez toi rebâtiront les ruines antiques ; \q les fondations de génération en génération, tu les relèveras ; \q et on t’appellera Réparateur de la brèche, \q Restaurateur des chemins pour habiter.
fr.B: Les tiens rebâtiront les ruines laissées depuis longtemps ; \q tu relèveras des fondations posées il y a des générations. \q On t’appellera celui qui bouche la brèche du mur, \q celui qui rend les routes habitables.
fr.R: Ton peuple reconstruira les villes détruites il y a longtemps. \q Tu bâtiras de nouveau sur les anciennes fondations. \q Les gens t’appelleront celui qui répare les murs démolis \q et qui rend les rues de nouveau habitables.

sw.L: Na [wale] walio miongoni mwenu watajenga magofu ya zamani; \q misingi ya vizazi vingi mtaiinua; \q nawe utaitwa Mwenye Kuziba Mahali Palipobomoka, \q Mwenye Kurejesha Njia za Kukaa.
sw.B: Watu wako watajenga upya magofu yaliyoachwa tangu zamani; \q utainua misingi iliyowekwa vizazi vingi vilivyopita. \q Utaitwa yule anayeziba pengo ukutani, \q yule anayefanya njia zifae kuishi kando yake.
sw.R: Watu wenu watajenga upya miji iliyoharibiwa zamani. \q Mtajenga juu ya misingi ya zamani tena. \q Watu watawaita wale wanaotengeneza kuta zilizobomoka, \q na kuzifanya njia ziwe tayari watu waishi tena.

decisions.choice: from you: people from among you, your own descendants
decisions.reason: The rebuilders come from the people addressed; the next line says "you" will raise the foundations.

decisions.choice: a breach: a gap broken through a city wall
decisions.reason: Enemies broke through walls, and repairing them was the first work of restoring a city (30:13; Nehemiah 6:1). Isaiah 44:26 and 61:4 also promise the ruins rebuilt.

decisions.choice: paths to dwell: roads restored so that the land can be lived in again
decisions.reason: The ways through the land will be fit for settled life once more.

source.text: אִם־תָּשִׁ֤יב מִשַּׁבָּת֙ רַגְלֶ֔ךָ עֲשׂ֥וֹת חֲפָצֶ֖יךָ בְּי֣וֹם קָדְשִׁ֑י וְקָרָ֨אתָ לַשַּׁבָּ֜ת עֹ֗נֶג לִקְד֤וֹשׁ יְהוָה֙ מְכֻבָּ֔ד וְכִבַּדְתּוֹ֙ מֵעֲשׂ֣וֹת דְּרָכֶ֔יךָ מִמְּצ֥וֹא חֶפְצְךָ֖ וְדַבֵּ֥ר דָּבָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: If you turn back from the Sabbath your foot, doing your pleasures on the day of my holiness, and call the Sabbath a delight, the holy [day] of Yahweh honored, and honor it [apart] from doing your ways, from finding your pleasure and speaking a word,

en.L: If from the Sabbath you turn back your foot, \q from carrying out your desires on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy day, \q and you call the Sabbath a delight, the holy [day] of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} honored, \q and you honor it, apart from doing your [own] ways, \q apart from finding your [own] desire and speaking a word,
en.B: If you hold back your steps on the Sabbath \q and do not chase your own interests on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy day; \q if you name the Sabbath a delight, the holy day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a day to honor, \q and honor it by leaving your own paths, your own pursuits, and your deal-making aside,
en.R: Keep the Sabbath day holy. \q Do not just do whatever you want on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy day. \q Call the Sabbath a day of joy. \q Treat the holy day of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with honor. \q Honor it by not doing your usual work. Do not do just what you want, and do not talk about business.

es.L: Si del sábado retraes tu pie, \q de hacer tus deseos en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} día santo, \q y llamas al sábado delicia, honrado el [día] santo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q y lo honras, apartándote de hacer tus [propios] caminos, \q de buscar tu [propio] deseo y de hablar palabra,
es.B: Si en sábado detienes tus pasos \q y no persigues tus propios intereses en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} día santo; \q si llamas al sábado una delicia, y al día santo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} un día para honrar, \q y lo honras dejando a un lado tus propios caminos, tus propios asuntos y tus negocios,
es.R: Guarda el día de sábado como día santo. \q No hagas simplemente lo que quieras en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} día santo. \q Llama al sábado un día de alegría. \q Trata con honra el día santo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. \q Hónralo no haciendo tu trabajo de siempre. No hagas solo lo que quieres, y no hables de negocios.

fr.L: Si tu détournes ton pied du sabbat, \q de faire tes volontés en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} jour saint, \q et si tu appelles le sabbat un délice, le [jour] saint {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} honorable, \q et si tu l’honores en ne suivant pas tes [propres] chemins, \q en ne trouvant pas ton [propre] plaisir et en ne tenant pas de discours,
fr.B: Si tu retiens tes pas le jour du sabbat \q et ne cours pas après tes propres intérêts en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} jour saint ; \q si tu appelles le sabbat un délice, et le jour saint {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} un jour à honorer, \q et si tu l’honores en laissant de côté tes propres chemins, tes propres affaires et tes marchandages,
fr.R: Respecte le sabbat comme un jour saint. \q Ne fais pas simplement ce que tu veux en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} jour saint. \q Appelle le sabbat un jour de joie. \q Traite avec honneur le jour saint {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. \q Honore-le en ne faisant pas ton travail habituel. Ne fais pas seulement ce que tu veux, et ne parle pas d’affaires.

sw.L: Ukiugeuza mguu wako usiivunje Sabato, \q usifanye mapenzi yako katika siku {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} takatifu, \q na kuiita Sabato siku ya furaha, siku takatifu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yenye heshima, \q na kuiheshimu, bila kufanya njia zako [mwenyewe], \q bila kutafuta mapenzi yako [mwenyewe] na kusema maneno,
sw.B: Ukiizuia miguu yako siku ya Sabato \q wala usifuatilie shughuli zako mwenyewe katika siku {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} takatifu; \q ukiiita Sabato siku ya furaha, siku takatifu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} siku ya kuheshimiwa, \q na kuiheshimu kwa kuziacha kando njia zako, shughuli zako na mapatano yako ya biashara,
sw.R: Iwekeni siku ya Sabato kuwa takatifu. \q Msifanye tu mnavyotaka katika siku {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} takatifu. \q Iiteni Sabato siku ya furaha. \q Itendeeni siku takatifu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa heshima. \q Iheshimuni kwa kutofanya kazi zenu za kawaida. Msifanye tu mnavyotaka, wala msizungumze habari za biashara.

decisions.choice: turn back your foot from the Sabbath: stop trampling the day with your own business
decisions.reason: The foot pictures going about one's affairs; the Law forbids ordinary work and trade on the Sabbath (Exodus 16:29; Jeremiah 17:21-22; Amos 8:5).

decisions.choice: your pleasure: your own business and interests
decisions.reason: The same word as 58:3. What is set aside is one's own affairs, not joy itself, since the Sabbath is to be a delight.

decisions.choice: speaking a word: talking business, making deals; or idle talk
decisions.reason: The phrase is brief. Next to "your ways" and "your business" it most likely means speaking of one's dealings.

decisions.choice: Keep the Sabbath day holy. Do not ...
decisions.reason: Readable turns the long condition into short commands; verse 14 says what follows.

source.text: אָ֗ז תִּתְעַנַּג֙ עַל־יְהוָ֔ה וְהִרְכַּבְתִּ֖יךָ עַל־בָּ֣מֳותֵיאָ֑רֶץ וְהַאֲכַלְתִּ֗יךָ נַחֲלַת֙ יַעֲקֹ֣ב אָבִ֔יךָ כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: then you will take delight in Yahweh, and I will make you ride on [the] high places of [the] land, and I will feed you [the] inheritance of Jacob your father; for [the] mouth of Yahweh has spoken.

en.L: then you will find your delight in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and I will set you riding on the heights of the land, \q and I will feed you [from] the inheritance of Jacob your father; \q for the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken.
en.B: then you will find joy in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q I will set you astride the high places of the land \q and nourish you from the inheritance of Jacob your father. \q For the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken.
en.R: If you do this, you will find your joy in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q I will give you victory and make you secure on the hills of the land. \q I will feed you with the good things of the land I gave to your ancestor Jacob. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} has said this.

es.L: entonces te deleitarás en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q y te haré cabalgar sobre las alturas de la tierra, \q y te alimentaré [con] la heredad de Jacob tu padre; \q porque la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ha hablado.
es.B: entonces encontrarás tu gozo en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Te haré montar sobre las alturas de la tierra \q y te sustentaré con la heredad de Jacob tu padre. \q Porque la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} lo ha dicho.
es.R: Si haces esto, encontrarás tu alegría en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Te daré la victoria y te haré estar seguro sobre las colinas de la tierra. \q Te alimentaré con las cosas buenas de la tierra que le di a tu antepasado Jacob. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mismo lo ha dicho.

fr.L: alors tu trouveras tes délices dans {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et je te ferai monter sur les hauteurs du pays, \q et je te nourrirai de l’héritage de Jacob ton père ; \q car la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} a parlé.
fr.B: alors tu trouveras ta joie dans {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Je te ferai chevaucher sur les hauts lieux du pays \q et je te nourrirai de l’héritage de Jacob ton père. \q Car la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} a parlé.
fr.R: Si tu fais cela, tu trouveras ta joie dans {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Je te donnerai la victoire et la sécurité sur les collines du pays. \q Je te nourrirai des bonnes choses du pays que j’ai donné à ton ancêtre Jacob. \q C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} qui l’a dit.

sw.L: ndipo utajifurahisha katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q nami nitakupandisha juu ya mahali palipoinuka pa nchi, \q nami nitakulisha [kwa] urithi wa Yakobo baba yako; \q kwa maana kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kimesema.
sw.B: ndipo utapata furaha katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Nitakuendesha juu ya vilele vya nchi \q na kukulisha kutoka urithi wa Yakobo baba yako. \q Kwa maana kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kimesema.
sw.R: Mkifanya hivi, mtapata furaha yenu katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Nitawapa ushindi na kuwafanya muwe salama juu ya vilima vya nchi. \q Nitawalisha kwa mazao mazuri ya nchi niliyompa babu yenu Yakobo. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} amesema hivi.

decisions.choice: ride on the heights of the land: the words of Deuteronomy 32:13
decisions.reason: Moses' song says God made Israel ride on the heights of the land and fed it from the field (Deuteronomy 32:13; 33:29). It pictures secure possession and victory.

decisions.choice: the inheritance of Jacob: the land promised to Jacob and his descendants
decisions.reason: To be fed from it is to enjoy its harvests in peace (Genesis 28:13-14).

decisions.choice: the mouth of the LORD has spoken: the promise is certain
decisions.reason: The same closing words seal promises in 1:20 and 40:5.

decisions.choice: give you victory and make you secure on the hills of the land
decisions.reason: Readable explains what riding on the heights pictures.
